when.en: Shortly before the conquest of Makkah (8 AH)

challenges: تسريب سر عسكري خطير من صحابي موثوق
مطالبة عمر بأشد عقوبة
خطر على الجماعة كلها
ar.chose: سأله أولًا «ما حملك على هذا؟»، وسمع عذره، ووازن الفعل بتاريخه في بدر، فعفا عنه.

lessons.self: قبل أن تحكم على من خذلك، اسأله: ما حملك على هذا؟
lessons.family: خطأ واحد من قريب وفيّ لا يمحو تاريخه كله.
lessons.work: عند تسريب معلومة من موظف قديم، تثبّت من دوافعه قبل العقوبة.
lessons.community: العدل يزن الفعل والنية والتاريخ معًا.

challenges: A serious military secret leaked by a trusted companion
‘Umar demanding the severest punishment
Danger to the whole community
alternatives: Judging him a traitor without hearing him
Ignoring the matter as if it had not happened
en.chose: He first asked, “What made you do this?”, heard his excuse, weighed the deed against his record at Badr, and pardoned him.
notDone: He did not judge before asking
He did not grant the maximum punishment
He did not deny the seriousness of the act itself

lessons.self: Before judging someone who let you down, ask them: what made you do this?
lessons.family: One mistake by a loyal relative does not erase their whole history.
lessons.work: When a long-serving employee leaks information, check their motives before punishing.
lessons.community: Justice weighs the act, the intention and the record together.

challenges: قدرة كاملة على من آذوه سنين
ذكريات الإخراج والقتل والأذى
توقع الناس للانتقام
ar.chose: سألهم «ما تظنون أني فاعل بكم؟» ثم عفا عنهم جميعًا: «اذهبوا فأنتم الطلقاء».

lessons.self: أعلى درجات القوة أن تعفو وأنت قادر.
lessons.family: حين ترجع إليك السلطة في الأسرة بعد أذى، لا تجعلها انتقامًا.
lessons.work: القائد المنتصر الذي يعفو يكسب ولاء خصومه.
lessons.community: العفو العام يبني مجتمعًا جديدًا بدل تكرار دوائر الثأر.

challenges: Full power over those who had harmed him for years
Memories of expulsion, killing and persecution
People expecting revenge
alternatives: Taking revenge on those who harmed him
Pardon with a reminder of their offences
en.chose: He asked them, “What do you think I will do with you?”, then pardoned them all: “Go, you are free.”
notDone: He did not list their offences

lessons.self: The highest strength is to forgive when you are able not to.
lessons.family: When authority in the family returns to you after harm, do not turn it into revenge.
lessons.work: A victorious leader who forgives wins the loyalty of his opponents.
lessons.community: A general amnesty builds a new society instead of repeating cycles of vengeance.

when.en: After the Battle of Hunayn (8 AH)

challenges: شعور فئة مخلصة بالظلم في التوزيع
حديث بين الشباب قد يتحول إلى فتنة
الحاجة إلى تأليف قلوب حديثي الإسلام
ar.chose: جمعهم وحدهم، وذكّرهم بتاريخهم معه، وشرح الحكمة، وطمأنهم بأنهم يذهبون برسول الله إلى رحالهم.

lessons.self: إذا شعرت بأنك ظُلمت في القسمة، فاسأل عن الحكمة قبل أن تحكم.
lessons.family: حين يشعر أحد الأبناء أن غيره أُعطي أكثر، اجلس معه واشرح له.
lessons.work: حين يتأثر الموظفون المخلصون بقرار، اشرح لهم وطمئنهم بقيمتهم.
lessons.community: الإصغاء لمشاعر الأوفياء يمنع الفتنة.

challenges: A loyal group feeling unfairly treated in the distribution
Talk among the young men that could turn into strife
The need to win the hearts of new Muslims
alternatives: Changing the distribution to please them
en.chose: He gathered them alone, reminded them of their history with him, explained the wisdom, and reassured them that they would return home with the Messenger of Allah.
notDone: He did not ignore their feelings
He did not reverse his considered decision

lessons.self: If you feel short-changed, ask about the wisdom before judging.
lessons.family: When a child feels another was given more, sit with them and explain.
lessons.work: When loyal staff are affected by a decision, explain it and reassure them of their worth.
lessons.community: Listening to the feelings of the loyal prevents strife.

when.en: After the expedition of Tabuk (9 AH)

challenges: تخلف بلا عذر عن أمر مهم
سهولة اختلاق عذر يُقبل
عزلة اجتماعية خمسين ليلة
alternatives: قبول عذر كاذب كما قُبل من غيره
ar.chose: قدّر صدق كعب، وأرجأ أمره إلى حكم الله، وأمر بمقاطعة محددة حتى نزلت التوبة، ثم استقبله بفرح.

lessons.self: الصدق في الاعتراف بالخطأ مؤلم أولًا ونجاة أخيرًا.
lessons.family: عاقب أبناءك بعقوبة محددة المدة، واستقبلهم بفرح بعد التوبة.
lessons.work: الموظف الذي يعترف بخطئه بصدق يستحق معاملة مختلفة عمن يختلق الأعذار.
lessons.community: المجتمع الذي يقدّر الصدق يربّي الصادقين.

challenges: Staying behind without excuse from an important command
How easy it would be to invent an acceptable excuse
Social isolation for fifty nights
alternatives: Accepting a false excuse, as was accepted from others
en.chose: He valued Ka‘b's honesty, deferred his case to Allah's judgement, ordered a limited boycott until the repentance was revealed, then received him with joy.
notDone: He did not publicly shame him
He did not taunt him after his repentance
He did not treat the honest and the liars alike

lessons.self: Honestly admitting a mistake hurts at first and saves in the end.
lessons.family: Discipline children with time-limited consequences, and welcome them joyfully after they repent.
lessons.work: An employee who honestly admits a mistake deserves different treatment from one who invents excuses.
lessons.community: A society that values honesty raises honest people.

challenges: فقد ابنه الصغير
استغراب بعض الناس من بكائه
الجمع بين الحزن والرضا
ar.chose: بكى ووصف بكاءه بأنه رحمة، وقال: «إن العين تدمع والقلب يحزن ولا نقول إلا ما يرضي ربنا».

lessons.self: دموعك على من فقدت رحمة لا ضعف.
lessons.family: علّم أبناءك أن الحزن مسموح، وأن الرضا يجتمع معه.
lessons.work: إن فقد زميلك عزيزًا، فلا تطلب منه التماسك؛ اسمح له بالحزن.
lessons.community: المجتمع الذي يسمح بالحزن الصادق أصح نفسيًا.

challenges: Losing his young son
Some people being surprised at his weeping
Holding grief and acceptance together
alternatives: Holding back tears to preserve dignity
en.chose: He wept and called his weeping mercy, saying: “The eye sheds tears and the heart grieves, and we say only what pleases our Lord.”
notDone: He did not suppress his grief
He said nothing that displeases Allah
He did not see weeping as a flaw

lessons.self: Your tears for someone you lost are mercy, not weakness.
lessons.family: Teach your children that grief is allowed and acceptance can go with it.
lessons.work: If a colleague loses a loved one, do not ask them to hold together; let them grieve.
lessons.community: A community that allows sincere grief is healthier.

challenges: أعراف قبلية وعنصرية راسخة
أكبر جمع من الناس في مكان واحد
آخر فرصة لإيصال المبادئ الكبرى
ar.chose: أعلن بوضوح قاطع أن لا فضل لعربي على عجمي ولا لأحمر على أسود إلا بالتقوى.
notDone: لم يربط التفاضل بأمر لا يملكه الإنسان

lessons.self: قيمتك في تقواك، لا في لونك ولا أصلك.
lessons.family: ربِّ أبناءك على أن الناس سواء، فلا عنصرية في البيت.
lessons.work: قيّم زملاءك بعملهم وخلقهم، لا بجنسيتهم أو أصلهم.
lessons.community: المجتمع العادل يرفض التمييز بكل أشكاله.

challenges: Deep-rooted tribal and racial customs
The largest gathering of people in one place
The last chance to convey the great principles
alternatives: Announcing the principle in a form that allowed exceptions
en.chose: He declared with absolute clarity that no Arab is better than a non-Arab, nor a red-skinned person than a black one, except through piety.
notDone: He did not leave the matter vague
He did not tie worth to anything beyond a person's choice

lessons.self: Your worth is in your piety, not your colour or origin.
lessons.family: Raise your children to see people as equals; no racism at home.
lessons.work: Judge colleagues by their work and character, not their nationality or origin.
lessons.community: A just society rejects discrimination in all its forms.

challenges: ألم جسدي من جذبة عنيفة
طلب فظ بلهجة جافية
إحراج أمام الناس
ar.chose: التفت إليه فضحك، ثم أمر له بعطاء.

lessons.self: الابتسامة في وجه الجفاء تنزع فتيل الموقف.
lessons.family: حين يطلب أحد أفراد أسرتك بفظاظة، قد يكون الإحسان أبلغ رد.
lessons.work: مع العميل الفظ، الهدوء والإحسان يحسمان أكثر من الجدال.
lessons.community: حلم الكبار يعلّم الآخرين الأدب دون كلمة.

challenges: Physical pain from a violent pull
A rude demand in a harsh tone
Embarrassment in front of people
alternatives: Refusing the request because of its rudeness
Rebuking him for his bad manners
en.chose: He turned to him, laughed, then ordered that he be given something.
notDone: He did not refuse the request

lessons.self: A smile in the face of rudeness defuses the situation.
lessons.family: When a family member asks rudely, kindness may be the most eloquent reply.
lessons.work: With a rude client, calm and generosity settle more than argument.
lessons.community: The forbearance of great people teaches manners without a word.

challenges: فعل صادم في مكان مقدس
اندفاع الصحابة لزجره بشدة
جهل الرجل بما فعل
ar.chose: قال «دعوه» حتى أتم، ثم أمر بالماء، وعلّمه برفق، وقال لأصحابه: «إنما بعثتم ميسرين».

lessons.self: قبل أن تصحح خطأ أحد، اسأل: هل يعلم أنه خطأ؟
lessons.family: صحح أخطاء أطفالك بعد أن يهدأ الموقف، وبرفق.
lessons.work: عالج خطأ الموظف الجديد بالتعليم لا بالفضيحة.
lessons.community: التيسير في التعليم يقرّب الناس من الدين.

challenges: A shocking act in a sacred place
The companions rushing to rebuke him harshly
The man's ignorance of what he was doing
alternatives: Letting the companions rebuke him immediately
Throwing him out of the mosque
Scolding him in front of people
en.chose: He said, “Leave him,” until he finished, then ordered water poured, taught him gently, and told his companions: “You were sent to make things easy.”
notDone: He did not interrupt him mid-act
He did not blow the mistake out of proportion

lessons.self: Before correcting someone's mistake, ask: do they know it is wrong?
lessons.family: Correct your children's mistakes after the moment has calmed, and gently.
lessons.work: Handle a new employee's mistake with teaching, not public shaming.
lessons.community: Making things easy in teaching brings people closer to the faith.

challenges: صحابي كبير أخطأ في حق المصلين
اتهام رجل بسيط بالنفاق
حماس ديني تجاوز المراعاة
ar.chose: غضب لحق المصلين، وقال: «أفتّان أنت يا معاذ؟»، وأعطاه بديلًا محددًا بسور قصيرة.

lessons.self: الحماس للخير يحتاج إلى مراعاة أحوال الناس.
lessons.family: لا تُثقل على أهلك في العبادة أو الواجبات فوق طاقتهم.
lessons.work: المسؤول يراعي ظروف الضعيف وصاحب الحاجة في فريقه.
lessons.community: التشدد ينفّر الناس، والتيسير يجمعهم.

challenges: A senior companion wronged those praying behind him
A simple man accused of hypocrisy
Religious zeal that overrode consideration
alternatives: Siding with Mu‘adh because of his standing
Blaming Mu‘adh without a practical alternative
en.chose: He was angered for the sake of those praying, said “Are you causing trouble, Mu‘adh?”, and gave him a concrete alternative of short chapters.
notDone: He did not favour Mu‘adh for his standing
He did not ignore the complaint
He did not stop at blame

lessons.self: Zeal for good needs consideration of people's circumstances.
lessons.family: Do not burden your family in worship or duties beyond their capacity.
lessons.work: A manager takes into account the weak and those with needs on the team.
lessons.community: Severity drives people away; ease brings them together.

challenges: إساءة مقنّعة في صورة تحية
غضب عائشة ورغبتها في الرد بأشد
الحاجة إلى عدم السكوت على الإساءة
ar.chose: رد بكلمة واحدة «وعليكم»، ونهى عائشة عن الفحش: «إن الله رفيق يحب الرفق في الأمر كله».

lessons.self: يمكنك أن ترد على الإساءة دون أن تفقد خلقك.
lessons.family: علّم أبناءك أن الرد على الإهانة لا يكون بالسب.
lessons.work: مع التعليق المسيء المبطن، رد قصير هادئ يكفي.
lessons.community: الرفق حتى مع المسيء يحفظ المجتمع من دوامة الشتائم.

challenges: A veiled insult disguised as a greeting
‘A’ishah's anger and wish to reply more harshly
The need not to stay silent about an insult
en.chose: He replied with one word, “And upon you,” and forbade ‘A’ishah from obscenity: “Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all matters.”
notDone: He did not ignore the insult
He did not cut off dealings

lessons.self: You can respond to an insult without losing your character.
lessons.family: Teach your children that answering an insult is not done with abuse.
lessons.work: With a veiled hostile remark, a short calm reply is enough.
lessons.community: Gentleness even with an offender protects society from a spiral of insults.

challenges: جنازة شخص على دين آخر
استغراب الصحابة من قيامه لها
حدود الاحترام عند اختلاف العقيدة
ar.chose: قام للجنازة، وأجاب بسؤال موجز: «أليست نفسًا؟»
notDone: لم يجعل اختلاف الدين سببًا لعدم الاحترام

lessons.self: احترام كرامة الإنسان لا يتوقف على دينه.
lessons.family: علّم أبناءك احترام جيرانهم وزملائهم من الأديان الأخرى.
lessons.work: قدّم العزاء والاحترام لزميلك المختلف عنك في الدين.
lessons.community: الإنسانية المشتركة أساس للتعايش مع الحفاظ على العقيدة.

challenges: The funeral of someone of another faith
The companions' surprise that he stood for it
The limits of respect when beliefs differ
alternatives: A long explanation of his position
en.chose: He stood for the funeral and answered with a brief question: “Is it not a soul?”
notDone: He did not let difference in religion become a reason for disrespect
He did not prolong the argument
He did not back down because of people's surprise

lessons.self: Respect for human dignity does not depend on someone's religion.
lessons.family: Teach your children to respect neighbours and classmates of other faiths.
lessons.work: Offer condolences and respect to a colleague of a different faith.
lessons.community: Shared humanity is a basis for coexistence while keeping one's beliefs.

challenges: غلام خادم على دين آخر في مرض الموت
حضور أبيه
الرغبة في هدايته دون ضغط
ar.chose: زاره وجلس عند رأسه، وعرض عليه الإسلام مرة برفق، واحترم دور أبيه.

lessons.self: الرحمة بالمريض لا تعرف حدود الدين أو المكانة.
lessons.family: زيارة المرضى من الجيران والخدم وإن اختلفوا عنك من بر الإنسانية.
lessons.work: اسأل عن العامل البسيط المريض في مكانك.
lessons.community: الدعوة بالرحمة لا بالضغط، واحترام الأسرة جزء منها.

challenges: A young servant of another faith on his deathbed
His father's presence
The wish to guide him without pressure
alternatives: Not visiting because of the difference in religion
en.chose: He visited, sat at his head, invited him to Islam once and gently, and respected his father's role.
notDone: He did not refuse to visit
He did not bypass the father

lessons.self: Mercy toward the sick knows no boundary of religion or status.
lessons.family: Visiting sick neighbours and helpers, even if different from you, is part of human kindness.
lessons.work: Ask after the humble worker who is ill at your workplace.
lessons.community: Invitation to faith is by mercy, not pressure, and respecting the family is part of it.

challenges: خلاف بين أقرب صاحبين
رفض عمر لاعتذار أبي بكر في البداية
تأثر النبي ﷺ لما وقع على أبي بكر
ar.chose: غضب لصاحبه الذي اعتذر فلم يُقبل اعتذاره، وذكّر بسابقته، حتى أشفق أبو بكر على عمر.
notDone: لم يتجاهل الظلم الواقع على المعتذر

lessons.self: إذا اعتذر لك أحد بصدق، فاقبل اعتذاره ولا تغلق الباب في وجهه.
lessons.family: في خلاف الإخوة، ذكّر كلًّا منهم بفضل الآخر.
lessons.work: حين يتخاصم زميلان، أنصف من اعتذر وذكّر بسابق الخير.
lessons.community: الصداقات الكبيرة تحتمل الخلاف إذا حضر الاعتذار وقبوله.

challenges: A dispute between his two closest companions
‘Umar at first refusing Abu Bakr's apology
The Prophet's distress at what happened to Abu Bakr
alternatives: Taking an angry side without recalling merit
en.chose: He was angered for his companion who had apologised and been refused, recalled his early merit, until Abu Bakr himself felt pity for ‘Umar.
notDone: He did not ignore the wrong done to the one who apologised
He did not let the dispute deepen

lessons.self: If someone sincerely apologises to you, accept it and do not shut the door in their face.
lessons.family: In disputes between siblings, remind each of the other's merit.
lessons.work: When two colleagues fall out, be fair to the one who apologised and recall past good.
lessons.community: Great friendships survive disagreement when apology is offered and accepted.
